fusions.name: Fault Line
fusions.desc: Chops into the ground and opens a narrow crack 5 tiles ahead, dealing 13 earth damage to everything along it and stunning it for 1 second.

fusions.name: Hewn Boulder
fusions.desc: Chops a boulder loose and sends it ahead, dealing 28 rock damage to the first enemy it meets. It bursts there, dealing 80% of the damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Heaved Slab
fusions.desc: Chops up a slab of stone 5 tiles long in front of you that blocks movement for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Scree Mantle
fusions.desc: When you strike with your weapon, you gain a shield worth 10% of your maximum health for 4 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.
